description_en: Add tags to Anti-DDoS Origin instances
description_zh: 为指定资源（DDoS原生防护实例）绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource to which you want to add tags. Set the value to INSTANCE, which indicates instances
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定标签的资源的类型，取值固定为INSTANCE，表示实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances to which you want to add tags. You can specify up to 51 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定标签的DDoS原生防护实例的ID列表。最多支持51个ID
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag to add.

If the specified key does not exist, a key is created
fields.help_zh:
要绑定的标签键。

如果您设置的标签键不存在，则表示新建该标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag to add.

If the specified tag value does not exist, the tag value is created
fields.help_zh:
要绑定的标签值。

如果您设置的标签值不存在，则表示新建该标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add. You can specify up to 21 tags
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定的标签（键值对）列表。最多支持21个标签对
parameters.name: tag
